name: mycrew-crew
description: Layer 5/5 — the crew: the ones who actually build the product. Three characters, each handing down to the next. The chief is your deputy over the whole product, one to a product, owning the plane and delegating each approved feature whole. A lead holds one feature across every repo it touches, spawned as a background session of its own and reaching the other leads only where its feature depends on theirs. A worker carries one assignment end to end through the pipeline and hands back a four-field report. Each carries how it runs the rung below, so there is nothing to load and nothing to forget. Only the worker writes code.
